text: The Manohara river at Jorpati overflowed after last night's rain and water entered the ground-floor houses. Families have moved upstairs and the lane is blocked by knee-deep water.
A landslide on the Arniko Highway near Sankhu has buried part of the road. Traffic is halted and rescue teams are searching a car that was hit.
A fire broke out in a restaurant on Lakeside, Pokhara this evening. The flames spread to two nearby shops and the street is closed to traffic while firefighters work.
Wednesday's tremor cracked the walls of a four-storey house in Bhaktapur. The family has moved out and officials say the building may collapse.
A cyclist was hit by a taxi near Patan Durbar Square and is bleeding from the head. Passersby are waiting for an ambulance and traffic is flowing normally.
A big tree fell across the road at Naikap after the storm, stopping all traffic. Buses are being rerouted and workers are cutting the tree.
Rain water from the hill flooded the ground floor of houses at Batulechaur, Pokhara. Residents have sandbags at the door and some rooms are unusable.
Rocks tumbled down the Shivapuri slope onto the road near Jorpati. No one is hurt but the road is impassable for cars.
Fire destroyed three stalls in the Kalimati vegetable market before dawn. Stall owners lost their stock, one vendor is being treated for burns, and the road past the market is open.
An elderly man collapsed at the Kirtipur bus park and people are doing first aid until the ambulance arrives.
बागमती नदी पारा बढेर तेकुको सडकमा पानी आएको छ। मानिसहरू घरको माथिल्लो तलामा छन् र बाटो पानीले ढाकिएको छ।
अरनिको राजमार्गको भक्तपुर नजिकैमा पहिरो आएर बाटो अवरुद्ध भएको छ। एउटा जीप पहिरोमा फसेको छ र उद्धारकर्मीहरू खोजिरहेका छन्।
पोखरा लेकसाइडमा एउटा रेस्टुरेन्टमा आगो लागेको छ। आगोले नजिकैका दुइटा पसलमा पनि फैलियो र अग्निशमनकर्मीहरू काम गरिरहेका छन्।
भक्तपुरको गल्लीमा चार तल्लाको घरको भित्तामा दरार परेको छ। परिवार बाहिर सरेको छ र घर खाली गर्न भनिएको छ।
पाटन दरबार स्क्वायर नजिक साइकल चालकलाई ट्याक्सी ठोक्यो। चालक बेहोस छ र एम्बुलेन्स आउन लागेको छ।
आँधीपछि ठूलो रुख बालाजुको सडकमा झरेको छ, सबै सवारीसाधन रोकिएका छन्। कामदारहरूले रुख काट्न थालेका छन्।
कालिमाटी तरकारी बजारमा बिहान आगो लागेर तीनवटा पसल जले। एक व्यापारीलाई झुलसेको उपचार भइरहेको छ र बाटो खुला छ।
माछापुच्छ्रे पहाडको झारबाट माटो र ढुङ्गा सडकमा झरेको छ। कसैको क्षति भएन तर बाटो गाडीले जान सकिएन।
किर्तिपुर बसपार्कमा एक वृद्ध व्यक्ति बेहोस भएका छन्। मानिसहरू प्राथमिक उपचार गरिरहेका छन्, बाटो खुला भएकाले एम्बुलेन्स छिटै पुग्न सकेको छ।
सिंगहा दरबार नजिकै पुरानो घर भत्किएको छ। भित्तामा दुई जना मानिस दबेका छन् र उद्धारकर्मीहरू खोजिरहेका छन्।
Kalimati ma pahiro gayo, bato band cha. Gadi haru atkeka chan.
Chabahil ma aago lagyo, dui pasal jalayo. Fire brigade pugyo.
Teku ma bagmati nadhi badhi, ghar haru ma pani ghusyo, bato pani le dhakeko cha. परिवारहरू माथिल्लो तलामा छन्।
Bhaisepati ma bike gadi ladayo, ek jana ghau lagyo, hospital liyincha.
Heavy rain swelled the Balkhu stream at Kalimati and water poured into the ground-floor shops early this morning. Owners are bailing water out and the lane is closed.
कालिमाटी नजिकै बाल्कु खोलामा पानी बढेर पसलका भुइँतलामा घुसेको छ। व्यापारीहरूले पानी निकाल्दै छन् र गल्ली बन्द छ।
ललितपुरको खोकना जाने बाटोमा पहिरो आएर बाटो रोकियो। तीनवटा गाडी ढुङ्गातल्ला भित्र फसेका छन् र उद्धार भइरहेको छ।
A landslide on the Khokana road in Lalitpur has buried the track and three vehicles are trapped under debris. Rescue crews are digging them out.
Something is wrong near the river, people should be careful.
